description: Collin Central Appraisal District appraisal data for tax years 2022 to 2025 from the Texas Open Data Portal (one source per year; unverified). See docs/registry/texas-sources.md, 'Prior-year rolls'.

sources.publisher: Collin Central Appraisal District (published on the Texas Open Data Portal, data.texas.gov)
sources.license: Public record. CCAD's open data page states the information is 'considered public domain' and distributed as is; the Socrata dataset has no license field (attribution: Collin Central Appraisal District)
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; the CCAD page says public domain
sources.notes: NOT VERIFIED because the host differs: the reviewed Collin source (tx-collin-cad) is files on link.collincad.org, while this is dataset vtby-uz4n (Appraisal Data 2022) on data.texas.gov, a platform whose own terms have not been read by a person (the same open item as the Comptroller entry). The publisher's page (collincad.org/open-data-portal, which links data.texas.gov/stories/s/mz7k-urqw) was read 2026-11-07 and again 2026-11-10 (text unchanged). Set verified to true once the Socrata terms are recorded. HEAD 2026-11-10: 200 with no Content-Length (Socrata streams CSV); size not published. count(*) = 416,572 rows; Last-Modified Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:12:23 GMT. 9 pages of 50,000 rows ordered by :id (extend the list if the count passes 450,000). LAYOUT DIFFERS from the Access LiteDatabaseCurrent.zip that tx_collin reads: a flat per-property CSV with nbhdcode, marketareacode, imprvclasscd, imprvmainarea, imprvunits, curr/prev/notice value columns, deed fields and ownername and owner address columns (personal data; the raw file stays under FactLot control). Same columns for 2022 to 2024; 2025 adds proprefid1, proprefid2 and gispropid. No adapter reads it yet, so this entry archives only. robots.txt on data.texas.gov: Crawl-delay 1; /resource/ is not disallowed. 2020 (hkzz-rrn8) and 2021 (cwex-zmku) also exist and are not configured.
